spans.s: Bhaṃ˚ (PJS), abbreviation of Bhaṇḍārin (especially in medieval Jain inscriptions). See Bhīṇḍārin, etc.
bhaṃḍi (CITD), same as Telugu baṃḍi, ‘a cart’; really ‘a cart load’.
Bhānasa-věrgaḍě (IE 8-3), Kannaḍa; same as Mahānas-ādhyakṣa; superintendent of the royal kitchen. Cf. Sūpakāra-pati, Khādyaṭapākika, Mahānasika.
